issues.description: Duplicate db.sh entries: both modified template db.sh and created a symlink db.sh in the recipe directory
issues.detail: The diff both adds TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH=downloads to egs2/TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh AND creates egs2/tal_zh_adult_teach/asr1/db.sh as a symlink to ../../TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh. This is consistent with other recipes, but the recipe's local/data.sh sources ./db.sh which will resolve via the symlink — fine. However if anyone runs prior to the template edit landing, TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH will be unset and data.sh errors. Verify both land together.

issues.description: Unquoted command substitutions in download_and_untar.sh break on paths with spaces
issues.detail: Lines `extract_dir=$(realpath $1)` and `zip_dir=$(realpath ${2:-$extract_dir})` are unquoted. If the download path contains spaces or special characters, realpath receives split arguments and fails or produces wrong output. Should be `extract_dir=$(realpath "$1")` and `zip_dir=$(realpath "${2:-$extract_dir}")`.

issues.description: Missing unzip is only warned, not fatal — script continues and fails later confusingly
issues.detail: Lines 9-11 check `if ! command -v unzip`, print a message, but do not exit. The script then proceeds to call `unzip -q ...` which will fail with a less actionable error. Add `exit 1` after the missing-unzip message. Similarly the usage block in lines 13-20 prints help but does not `exit 1`, so invalid argument counts silently proceed.

issues.description: README links to a config path that does not exist
issues.detail: README.md line 16 references `./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml` (with a `train/` subdirectory) but the actual file is `conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml`. The markdown link will 404 for anyone clicking through.

issues.description: data.sh sources db.sh after parse_options.sh, so $TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH check fails for `--downloads_dir` flag flow
issues.detail: data.sh runs `. ./utils/parse_options.sh` then `. ./db.sh`. parse_options expects the variables it parses to be pre-declared in the calling script, but `downloads_dir` is declared above, so OK. However `local/download_and_untar.sh "${TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH}" "${downloads_dir}"` passes `downloads_dir` which may be empty; download_and_untar then uses `${2:-$extract_dir}` so empty arg becomes literal empty string, not unset, defeating the default. Use `"${downloads_dir:-}"` handling or omit arg when empty.

issues.description: Aggressive sed transliteration silently corrupts Chinese transcripts beyond punctuation removal
issues.detail: data.sh strips `Ａ→A`, `#`, `=`, `、`, `，`, `？`, `。`, and trailing spaces. The list is ad-hoc — other full-width punctuation (`！`, `：`, `；`, `「」`, etc.) is kept, producing inconsistent vocabulary. Also `sed 's/Ａ/A/g'` only handles full-width A; other full-width latin letters in the corpus remain. Document the rationale or use a comprehensive normalization step.

review.summary: New ASR recipe for TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH follows ESPnet recipe template conventions and includes reasonable training/decoding configs with published CER results. Main concerns: download_and_untar.sh has unquoted command substitutions and a non-fatal `unzip` missing check that will produce confusing failures; the README links to a non-existent config path; and the transcript normalization sed pipeline is ad-hoc and may leave inconsistent full-width punctuation in the vocabulary. The recipe structure (symlinks, configs, run.sh) appears standard and consistent with sibling recipes.
